name: mcp-genelab
summary: MCP server for querying the NASA GeneLab Knowledge Graph with specialist tools for differential gene expression, DNA methylation, and organism abundance analyses (per-assay and cross-assay), plus DE/DM overlap detection, volcano and Venn plotting, session-scoped resource-based plot delivery, and ALB health/usage-metrics endpoints for shared-process (ECS Fargate) deployment.
